name: keyreach
description: A CLI tool that gives AI Agents the ability to fetch web content, search the internet, and interact with social media platforms. All output is structured JSON or Markdown, safe for LLM consumption. Supports automatic backend fallback — if one source fails, it tries another.
author: your-org

commands.name: fetch
commands.description: Fetch and extract the text content of any public web page or social media profile.  The tool automatically selects the best backend and falls back if needed.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The full URL to fetch (must start with http:// or https://).

parameters.name: --channel
parameters.description: Force a specific backend channel. Leave empty for automatic selection.

parameters.name: --format
parameters.description: Output format. Use 'json' for structured parsing.

examples.description: Force Jina Reader for a JS-heavy page

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the web and return structured results (title, URL, snippet).

parameters.name: --limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–20).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check the health of all registered backend channels.

commands.name: skill-register
commands.description: Re-generate this skill.json file or print instructions.

parameters.name: --print-only
parameters.description: Print instructions to stdout without writing a file.

decision_guide: Use 'fetch' when you need the full text of a specific URL. Use 'search' when you need to discover URLs for a topic. Use 'status' to check if backends are available before a batch operation. Always check the 'status' field in the response first before reading 'content'.
